rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and aligns with the provided 3AA grading, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, and thinned zona. Slight overstatement of image-derived certainty and a few features not fully verifiable from a single static image prevent a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, cycle history, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with clear links between morphology, age, diagnosis, and prognosis. Minor issue: the implantation estimate is somewhat optimistic relative to typical untested Day 5 blastocyst outcomes, though caveats are acknowledged.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer in a young patient with a high-quality blastocyst and attention to hydrosalpinx/endometrium. Slight overemphasis on implantation probability and some speculative fresh-cycle considerations keep it from full marks.

Provides practical next steps such as proceeding with single embryo transfer, confirming absence of hydrosalpinx, assessing endometrial and hormonal context, and outlining future evaluation only if repeated failure occurs. Useful and clinically applicable, though not highly detailed on transfer protocol specifics.
